exactly_one_unusual_experiment.name: PRE_GUARD_NON_SQLITE_LIBRARY_SHADOW
exactly_one_unusual_experiment.setup: Copied the host libcrypto.so.3 into a run-owned temporary lib directory; launched /usr/bin/python3 -I -S with LD_LIBRARY_PATH set to that directory; imported hashlib; inspected /proc/self/maps.
exactly_one_unusual_experiment.interpretation: SUPPORTED: the intentional SQLite loader search directory can influence non-SQLite native dependency selection before the child Python admission guard. This independently replicates the loader-search mechanism class already motivating V6; it is not production exploit proof.

generated_reality.hypothesis: V6 directory ancestry trust may be sufficient when the final release bundle guarantees every loader-visible object under the search root is deployment-owned and immutable to Frank.
generated_reality.counter_reality: Directory ownership/write-mode alone does not attest every pre-existing regular file or loader-visible subpath. A pre-existing non-root-owned/owner-writable dependency can remain mutable in place without changing its root-owned non-writable parent directory; if selected as DT_NEEDED before the child guard, V6 directory-only trust is insufficient.
generated_reality.hidden_assumption: All loader-visible siblings, symlink targets, glibc-hwcaps subdirectories and dependency objects inherit the same deployment trust as the directory and pinned SQLite DSO.
generated_reality.falsifier: Inventory/attest the exact installed loader-visible search tree and fail closed when any selected/searchable sibling or nested object is non-root-owned, writable, special, or resolves outside the trusted tree; compare against a clean trusted release bundle.
generated_reality.predicted_if_hypothesis_right: Exact productive bundle inventory shows all loader-visible objects/subpaths deployment-owned and immutable; additional runtime tree scanning is redundant.
generated_reality.predicted_if_counter_right: At least one loader-visible object/subpath is independently mutable despite trusted directory ancestry, or a controlled ordinary regression can demonstrate such a bundle is admitted by V6's current directory-only check.
